Game Overview

In Weighted Seesaw, the core idea is straightforward: balance brain-twisting puzzles with perfectly weighted precision in Weighted Seesaw. Strategically place blocks on a seesaw, using analytical skills akin to Tetris, ensuring they stabilize for the crucial countdown. Challenge your geometry prowess in this addictive 2D puzzle, where every placement counts for equilibrium. Can you master the art of balance?
